CCH/
N X 75
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
S. 1. Special Branch S/4/3/4/ File No.................... Date....August 14. 1941.......
SUBJECT: Mrs. Shura Purvey - Address

Further to report dated July 8th on the
above subject, the undersigned with the assistance
of the French Police on the 13-8-41 attempted to
locate Mr. Aron Kitzis at 833/12 Avenue Joffre where
he had had an office up till about 2 weeks ago. Not
being able to locate Mr. Kitzis a message was left
with one of his acquaintances asking Mr. Kitzis
to call the undersigned by telephone upon receipt of the
message.

At 4 p.m. 13-8-41, the undersigned received
a telephone call from Mrs. Purvey stating that she
had been to see Mr. Cox of H.B.M. Consulate. She
also gave her address, which she claimed was only
temporary, as 403 Route des Soeurs. Both these
statements were substantiated by Mr. Cox.

D. Ceur.
D. S.
A. C. (Special Branch).

报告
S. 1. 特别处 S/4/3/4/ 档案号.................... 日期....1941年8月14日.......
主题：Shura Purvey 夫人 - 地址

继7月8日关于上述主题的报告之后，本报告人于1941年8月13日在法国警察的协助下，试图在霞飞路833弄12号寻找 Aron Kitzis 先生，他大约两周前曾在此设有办公室。由于未能找到 Kitzis 先生，便向他的一个熟人留下口信，请 Kitzis 先生在收到口信后通过电话与本报告人联系。

1941年8月13日下午4时，本报告人接到 Purvey 夫人的电话，称她已去拜会英国驻华领事馆的 Cox 先生。她还提供了她的地址，声称这只是临时地址，即修女院路（Route des Soeurs）403号。这两项陈述均得到 Cox 先生的证实。

D. Ceur.
D. S.
A. C. (特别处)。

Dear Mr. Sharman,

Your letter No.895 of the
7th July regarding Mrs. Purvey.

this lady's present whereabouts?
She has not called to see me about
her registration but I am told she
has left Shanghai - with her
daughter - for North China.

Yours sincerely,
Cox.

Assistant Commissioner,

With reference to the attached letter from H.B.M.
Consulate-General re the departure of Mrs. Shura Purvey

that they have not left Shanghai up to the present date.

and her daughter do not live at the address they had
given, that is Lane 833/12 Avenue Joffre, and their

SHANGHAI
26th June, 1941 895
8 7 41

Dear Mr. Sharman,

Many thanks for your letter of 5th June
No.N995, regarding Mrs. Shura Purvey and her
daughter.

Although this woman called to see me, at
my request, on the 13th June, she has not yet
registered at this Consulate-General and I am
informed that she and her daughter have proceeded
to Tientsin.

I should be grateful if you could obtain
any confirmation of this.

Yours sincerely,

V. Sharman, Esquire,
Assistant Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O. BOX 259. SHANGHAI.
28th May, 1941.

Dear Mr. Sharman,

I think you have considerable information in your records regarding a thoroughly undesirable British subject named Mrs. Shura PURVEY.

She and her daughter, Mina KITZIS (who is not a British subject) are being deported from Singapore and should arrive shortly by the s.s. "ANKING".

I should be grateful if you would let me know their address when they arrive here.

Yours sincerely,

V. Sharman, Esquire,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（批：5 6 4 S.I.）

REPORT

Scl. Special Branch. S77777. File No.................... Date........June 4, 1941.

（印：SECRET x See also E1037）

SUBJECT: Mrs. x SHURA PURVEY } History
               x MINA KITZIS   }

Mrs. Shura Purvey first came to the notice of
S.M. Police in 1926 in a letter to the Commissioner
of Police, Hongkong, from the Acting Commandant, Cairo
City Police. The letter states that in August 1926
one Aron Kitzis and his mistress Shurah Purvey sailed
from Port Said for Hongkong. Kitzis was reported to
be a notorious Souteneur and pimp, who served a term
of imprisonment in France for misappropriation and was
expelled from Egypt as an undesirable character and a
menace to public safety. He lived for some time on
the proceeds of a brothel exploited by Shura Purvey.

The letter states Kitzis had a daughter by a
former mistress and that Purvey gained possession of
the child, which she claimed as her own and had entered
on her passport as her own daughter.

After leaving Bombay, where she conducted a brothel
at 26, Lamington Road, Purvey stayed for awhile in
Egypt. Shortly prior to her departure from Bombay,
a Bessarabian Jew named Moritz Speigel was murdered,
and although no positive proof was forthcoming strong
grounds existed for believing that Kitzis and Purvey
instigated the murder and paid the actual assassins
to carry it out. Because of this strong suspicion
Kitzis and Purvey were expelled from Egypt.

Shura Purvey married an Englishman named Purvey
in Bombay, thus obtaining British Nationality. Purvey
abandoned the woman shortly after the marriage and was
last heard of in Colombo.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 5/4/41）

报告

Scl. 特别处。 S77777. 档案号.................... 日期........1941年6月4日。

（印：秘密 x 另见 E1037）

主题：x SHURA PURVEY 夫人 } 履历
               x MINA KITZIS   }

Shura Purvey 夫人首次引起上海公共租界警务处注意是在1926年，当时开罗市警察局代理局长致函香港警务处处长。信中指出，1926年8月，Aron Kitzis 及其情妇 Shurah Purvey 从塞得港乘船前往香港。据报道，Kitzis 是一名臭名昭著的皮条客和鸨母，曾因挪用公款在法国服刑，并因系不良分子及公共安全威胁而被驱逐出埃及。他曾靠 Shura Purvey 经营的妓院收入生活了一段时间。

信中指出，Kitzis 与前情妇育有一女，Purvey 取得了该孩子的监护权，声称是其亲生女儿，并在护照上将其登记为自己的女儿。

Purvey 在离开孟买后曾在埃及停留一段时间，她在孟买 Lamington Road 26号经营一家妓院。就在她离开孟买前不久，一名名为 Moritz Speigel 的比萨拉比亚犹太人被谋杀，虽然尚无确凿证据，但有充分理由相信 Kitzis 和 Purvey 唆使了这起谋杀案并出资雇佣实际行凶者实施谋杀。基于这种强烈的嫌疑，Kitzis 和 Purvey 被驱逐出埃及。

Shura Purvey 在孟买嫁给了一名名为 Purvey 的英国人，从而获得了英国国籍。Purvey 在婚后不久便抛弃了该女子，最后一次有人听说他在科伦坡。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特别处 1941年4月5日）

SUBJECT: ( 2 )

Mrs. Purvey, who was born in Kieff, Russia, was
in Shanghai in 1926 and 1935.
on 31.5.41
She again arrived here from Singapore per China
Navigation Co's steamer "An King", in company with
her daughter Miss M. Purvey. Her present address in
Shanghai is not known. Boarding House Section has
been asked to endeavour to ascertain this and a further
report will be forwarded when this information is to
hand.
